dedupe_keys.name: eurostat lucas land use and land cover area frame survey

description: LUCAS, the land use and land cover area frame survey of Eurostat, is an in-situ survey that gives detailed information on specific points and harmonised, comparable statistics on land use and land cover for the territory of the European Union. Each survey produces three kinds of information: microdata on land cover, land use and environmental parameters at every surveyed point; point and landscape photographs in the four cardinal directions; and estimates of land cover and land use computed from weighted point data. LUCAS observations also serve as ground truth for satellite products such as the JRC EUCROPMAP crop type map. Access is free: microdata, photos and estimates can be downloaded from the Eurostat LUCAS pages and database. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (European Commission reuse policy: EU-owned content under CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted). Coverage is the EU. Caveats: point samples need weighting for area estimates, as the page notes. For simulation it provides ground observations of land cover and agricultural use for exposure mapping, validation of land cover and crop maps, and land-use scenarios. Related catalogue records include JRC EUCROPMAP and the EU Farm Sustainability Data Network.
